annotations.title: Change and save or submit your benefits enrollment

description: Make elections in an open benefit event (e.g. annual enrollment) and then Save for Later (`action: "save"`) or Review and Sign and Submit it (`action: "submit"` — signs the electronic signature and submits your elections). Each change names a `planType` (part of its name, e.g. "medical", "dependent care") and either a `plan` to choose, `waive: true`, or an `annualContribution` in dollars for an HSA/FSA (with or without `plan`). Plan types you do not mention keep what the event already has; changes already in place are skipped. Use `workday_get_benefit_enrollment` first to see the plan types, plans and prices. After the write the event is re-read to verify it. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

action.description: `save` = Save for Later (a draft); `submit` = Review and Sign, accept, and Submit.

changes.description: The elections to change. Empty with `action: "submit"` submits the enrollment as it stands.

annualContribution.description: HSA/FSA amount for the year, in dollars (e.g. `7800`).

plan.description: The plan to choose (part of its name).

planType.description: The plan type, e.g. `medical`, `USA Dependent Care FSA`.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

event.description: Part of the event's inbox title, when more than one benefit event is open. Default: the newest.
